detailed_description: SEO Title Generator creates title tag options from a page topic, target keyword, optional brand name, and brand placement setting. The real component shows Google-style previews, character counts, and length status so you can compare concise search snippets before choosing a title that fits your page and SERP intent. It does not fetch search results, measure ranking difficulty, or guarantee rankings.
usage_steps: Enter the page topic and target keyword.
Choose no brand, brand before, or brand after placement.
Review the title options, character status, and Google-style preview before copying a draft.
usage_examples: Draft title tags for a landing page or tool page.
Compare branded and unbranded title options.
Check whether a title may be too short or likely to truncate.

faqs.question: SEO Title Generator is free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool runs free in the browser and does not require an account.

faqs.question: Does the tool upload my inputs?
faqs.answer: No. The calculation or generation runs locally in the browser.

faqs.question: Does it guarantee better rankings?
faqs.answer: No. It creates title drafts and length guidance only. Ranking depends on page quality, relevance, competition, and many other signals.

faqs.question: Does it preview Google results?
faqs.answer: Yes. The component includes a simple Google-style preview so you can compare how title drafts may read in search.
